Latin word

terreō

terreō, terrēre, terruī, territum

verb, second conjugation

frighten, scare

In this lexicon

  • frighten

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 2.16.4: nec mē ista terrent; Traupman 319, 374

Examples

  • Nec mē ista terrent quae mihi ā tē ad timōrem fīdissimē atque amantissimē prōpōnuntur.

    Nor am I frightened by the things you so faithfully and lovingly set before me to make me afraid.Cic. Fam. 2.16.4
